c74object.name: evi.lpg~
c74object.digest: Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation for your west coast synthesis fun
c74object.description: Circuit modelled emulation of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate, unique version of a two-pole Sallen and Key filter, based on 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano DAngelo, 2013 . In evieve this is all audio rate inputs to control the voltage input to the gate, with additional features such as extra feedback resistors (boom ) and simultaneous filter outputs. Refactored code for optimal CPU usage.

inlet.description: Audio rate ping to attack the filter gate.
Filter resonance. Effect depends on other settings, such as @boom, @lpg and @vca.
Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG, thus increasing the starting point of the LPG filter sweep. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.
Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG, thus extending the frequency range of the LPG filter sweep. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG, from large range to small range. Can be used as a classic sounding Lowpass filter cutoff sweeper. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

outlet.description: Quirky bandpass version of the gate.
Quirky highpass version of the gate.
Aux output of the initial envelope follower that begins the ping of the LPG. Can be useful for synchronous downstream processing.

objarg.name: upsample
objarg.description: Oversampling factor for the core filter algorithm. Can be 2, 4 or 8. Default 4. Can only be a typed in argument.

attribute.name: boom
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Only has effect if the 'lpg' attribute is on. Smoothly crossfades additional resistors into the feedback path while maintaining filter stability. This can have a drastic effect on the tone of the filter and the resonance behaviour.

attribute.name: lpg
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between filter and gate behaviour.

attribute.name: nonlin
attribute.description: Turning this off is atypical behaviour. On (the default) engages the nonlinearities in the filter/gate structure. However, it can be very interesting triggering it linearly, but if you do so be careful of overall gain. (In the gen~ only version of the LPG, @nonlin is only available at oversample 1x and 2x).

attribute.name: offsetsmooth
attribute.description: Smooth the control offset inlet. Useful if using floats on that inlet. Turn off if modulating at audio rate.

attribute.name: response
attribute.description: To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. But sometimes it does make a difference. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper.

attribute.name: scalesmooth
attribute.description: Smooth the control scale inlet. Useful if using floats on that inlet. Turn off if modulating at audio rate.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time for the interpolated 'vca', 'lpg' and 'boom' controls.

attribute.name: sweepsmooth
attribute.description: Smooth the control sweep inlet. Useful if using floats on that inlet. Turn off if modulating at audio rate.

attribute.name: vactrolcontroldamp
attribute.description: Low shelving filter damp, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped.

attribute.name: vactrolcontrolhz
attribute.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'.

attribute.name: vactrolscalar
attribute.description: Scale the output amplitude of the vactrol envelope at the beginning of the ping chain. The default is '10.' which seems to work well, but very different behaviour can be achieved by modifying this. In general it is better to keep this relatively low and achieve scaling behaviour with the 'Offset', 'Scale' and 'Sweep' inlets.

attribute.name: vca
attribute.description: Core filter/gate functionality. Smoothly switch or interpolate between LP(G) and VCA behaviour. Using the block as a pure VCA is useful but far less fun. Ultimately this can be thought of as a gate damping effect, darkening the tone.

c74object.discussion: The code of this abstraction can also be used entirely inside gen~ / GenExpr using the evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp abstraction (with internal oversampling) and evi_control_lpg_buchla.gendsp for control. See the 'gen~' tab of the helpfile for details.
